absences: No new buyer deal (signed or announced) dated after 2026-10-21 found with a fetchable primary page. Searched microreactor PPA/MOU/LOI for Oct 2026 and company-specific queries (Aalo, Valar, Deep Fission, NANO, Last Energy). Deep Fission's Kansas binding PPA (2026-10-20) is already shipped as deep-fission-gpda-master-energy-purchase-2026-10-20.

Eielson (eielson): the DAF release and the Alaska Beacon page both returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch, so no 2026 status could be read from a primary page. The 2023 DLA intent-to-award to Oklo was rescinded in Sept 2023; the shipped 2025-06-11 NOITA is a separate, later notice and was not contradicted. Not checked. The shipped binding flag (true) on a notice of intent to award is not an executed instrument under the contract rule; left for the main session to review.
Equinix-Radiant (equinix-radiant): searches returned only 2025 items (Aug 2025 preorder, Radiant Oak Ridge factory, DOME plans). No 2026 status found. Not checked.

Oklo-Switch (oklo-switch): the June 2026 10-Q excerpt (first 100,000 of 148,391 characters) states 'we signed a 12 gigawatt (GW) Master Power Agreement with Switch, Ltd.' and does not say binding or non-binding. No conversion to binding terms found. Not checked.

ANPI JBSA, Buckley, Malmstrom (anpi-jbsa, anpi-buckley, anpi-malmstrom): April 2026 pairings (Antares-JBSA, Radiant-Buckley, Westinghouse-Malmstrom) matched in search summaries only; no fetch. No verdict written.
Last Energy Texas (uk-lastenergy and the Haskell County plan): no 2026 customer agreement found; the Haskell County plan is 2025 reporting. Not checked.

Web-leads out of this lane, not fetched: lead 1 (BWXT-Antares TRISO fuel contract, fuel vendor-to-vendor); lead 2 (NANO-Hyundai Engineering MOU, an EPC partner rather than a buyer); lead 3 (AIDEA share purchase in NuCube, an investor); lead 4 (Antares Mark-1 DSA, regulatory); lead 5 (Westinghouse eVinci commercial cancellation, vendors); lead 7 (Fortune context piece); lead 8 (NRC prior-authorization rule, politics); lead 9 (Westinghouse LEU+ plant, fuel).

Web-leads lead 6 (Neutron Bytes, 2026-10-24) fetched. Named buyers and hosts in it are already shipped (Navy/Crane) or are large reactors (Dairyland Genoa, 100 MW SMR; Indiana and Kentucky utilities). Deployable Energy at INL DOME is a DOE test, not a buyer.

NANO Nuclear with BaRupOn LLC (1 GW feasibility study; LAMP data center campus, Texas): the announcement date could not be read from the search results, so it was not added. Date needed before it can be a record.
Penn State FRONTIER: the 2025 letter of intent with Westinghouse is a signed LOI and the 2025 RFP was for an architect-engineer firm, so it was not added as a pipeline row.
Idaho Advanced Energy Consortium RFI: a consortium offering support, not a buyer; responses were due 2026-07-01.
Wise County VA (pipeline row): the study was expected to finish in December 2026 per July 2026 coverage; final report not found.

checks.claim: Five vendors selected for five named bases on 2026-08-26, up to $2.2bn across FY2027-FY2031 under milestone-based Other Transactions agreements the Army says it is negotiating; four of the nine candidate sites are still unassigned
checks.evidence: Army.mil release dated August 26, 2026 names five vendors and bases (Antares-Fort Bragg, BWXT-Fort Campbell, General Atomics EMS-Fort Hood, Radiant-Fort Benning, Westinghouse Government Services-Fort Drum), up to a combined $2.2 billion across FY2027-2031, and says the vendors were down-selected for negotiation of Other Transactions Authority-based agreements. It says additional Army and other Service sites will be announced at a later date. The page does not state 'four of nine', so that count is unchecked.
